# Code of conduct

Everyone should be able to contribute to EnoughUI without harassment or discrimination. This standard applies to issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions, project events, and conduct while representing the project.

Be respectful and specific. Welcome people with different backgrounds and levels of experience. Discuss ideas and behavior rather than making personal attacks. Accept constructive feedback, acknowledge mistakes, and help resolve disagreements.

Harassment, discriminatory language, threats, sexual advances, sharing private information without consent, and repeated disruption are unacceptable. Good-faith disagreement and a report of harmful conduct are not grounds for retaliation.

## Reporting and enforcement

For public spam or an immediate disruption, use GitHub's reporting tools. For a confidential conduct concern, contact a repository administrator using a private contact method listed on their GitHub profile. Do not post a person's private information or sensitive allegations in a public issue. If the concern involves a maintainer, contact another administrator of the EnoughTools organization.

Maintainers will handle reports discreetly, assess the available evidence, and consider the reporter's safety. Depending on severity and recurrence, they may ask for a correction, remove content, limit participation, or temporarily or permanently exclude a participant. Maintainers are held to the same standards. A person affected by an enforcement decision may request review by an administrator who was not involved in that decision.

The project administrators are responsible for keeping a usable private reporting contact available on their profiles and for addressing reports without retaliation.
